decisions.reason: The AXP2101 lower-pad cooling requirement does not change the main-board source-selection or diode OR-ing behavior.
AXP2101 package cooling is distinct from battery overcharge, overdischarge, and battery thermal-protection requirements.
The lower-pad heat-transfer requirement does not alter the battery connector, pinout, placement, voltage range, or connection destination.
The source establishes a component-level thermal-layout constraint but does not change the board dimensions, orientation, mounting holes, or connector arrangement.
The AXP2101 thermal-pad requirement does not affect the charge-status indicator, connector, resistors, or population settings.
Heat transfer from the AXP2101 package is separate from monitoring battery temperature through the J_BAT NTC.
The package-cooling constraint does not change the DCDC1 voltage setpoint, I2C configuration, rail target, or diode-drop compensation.
The AXP2101 lower-pad requirement does not alter the separate MT3608 boost-enable control or its powered loads.
The thermal-layout requirement does not change the USB-C connector functionality or sourceability constraints.
The source requires effective heat transfer through the lower pad but does not specify or change the eight-layer stack.
The AXP2101 cooling requirement is unrelated to the power board's TVS-based ESD protection.

The source asks whether separate manufacturing instructions are needed, but it does not require any new production-package content; the supplied context states that the board design already handles cooling.
